no_adcom_quote.quote: The application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or other external consultants, as it did not raise significant efficacy or safety concerns.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA761121 (POLIVY). Both the Summary Review (Section 9) and the Medical Review (Section 9) state the application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or other external consultants because it did not raise significant efficacy or safety concerns. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee concerns linked to changes in the approval.
